releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.24

- Adds the Strava detailed-profile read scope needed to verify athlete-wide FTP after a profile write.
- Preserves granted scopes across Strava token refreshes and gives a specific one-time reconnection message for older authorizations.
- Uses Strava's current API base URL for profile, activity, and starred-segment requests.
- Publishes first so Bradley's Mac and every other installation use the same signed automatic-update path.
- Keeps future automatic-update rollback copies out of Applications.
